content.caseIdentity: V. Tulasamma v. Sesha Reddy, (1977) 3 SCC 99
content.facts: The Supreme Court considered a dispute requiring interpretation of the governing family-law provision or closely connected statutory rule.
questionsBeforeCourt: What is the correct legal interpretation and application of the governing statutory rule?
content.ratioDecidendi: A right in property referable to a pre-existing legal entitlement, including maintenance, falls within the enlargement principle of s. 14(1); s. 14(2) concerns a fresh restricted grant.
content.holding: A right in property referable to a pre-existing legal entitlement, including maintenance, falls within the enlargement principle of s. 14(1); s. 14(2) concerns a fresh restricted grant.
